questions.prompt: What is final perspective in this chapter?
choices: A broad practical view on what a life amounts to when seen from the end
A way of ignoring ordinary life in favor of big moments
A comforting mood that avoids judgment

explanation.gentle: Final perspective means viewing a life from the widest lens possible.
explanation.direct: The chapter defines it as death's broad practical view on what the life really amounts to.
explanation.competitive: It is the last audit on the whole build.

questions.prompt: Why do tiny moments matter here?
choices: Because they are always emotionally sweeter than larger commitments
Because repeated ordinary moments make up much of what a life actually is
Because big milestones never matter at all

explanation.gentle: Tiny moments matter because so much of life is made from them.
explanation.direct: The chapter treats repeated ordinary uses of time as important because they compose more of a life than spectacle does.
explanation.competitive: The reps matter because they carry most of the build.

questions.prompt: What distinction is central to this chapter?
choices: Living well versus impressiveness
Luck versus planning
Caution versus boldness

explanation.direct: The chapter separates admiration and spectacle from the deeper question of whether the life was coherently spent.
explanation.competitive: The highlight reel is not the same as a strong build.

Reject every visible opportunity because ordinary life is all that counts
Ask which option contributes more clearly to a well-used life when the whole structure is judged

questions.prompt: What are priorities in this chapter?

What a person repeatedly protects, returns to, and spends life on
Only the largest commitments on the calendar

explanation.direct: The chapter defines priorities by recurring allocation, not by theory or image.
explanation.competitive: Priorities are what the life keeps feeding.

Because it treats ordinary moments as morally weighty due to the role they play in composing a life
Because it avoids talking about ordinary life entirely

explanation.competitive: The small matters because it carries the build.

questions.prompt: How can ordinary moments carry moral weight?

By replacing every larger commitment with comfort

questions.prompt: According to the chapter's threshold test, when does a repeated use of time belong to a well-lived life?
choices: When it still looks like part of a coherent and rightly spent life when viewed from the end
When it feels pleasant in the moment regardless of the larger pattern
When it creates as much visible admiration as possible

explanation.gentle: A repeated use of time belongs when it still looks right under final perspective.
explanation.direct: The chapter tests ordinary repetition by whether it helps compose a coherent, durable, and well-used life.
explanation.competitive: If the rep survives the last audit, it earns its place in the build.
